age the servers saved in a project

Options:
 --project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently

updated project)
 -h, --help display help for command

Commands:
 create|add [option
s] Create a saved MCP server\n get [options] Get one saved MCP server\n revisions [options] List a saved
server's stored revisions, newest\n first: captures of its tools and server info\n revision [options]
Read one stored revision of a saved server: its\n tools and server info\n revision-diff [option
s] Compare two stored revisions of a saved server:\n tools added, removed and changed, and server inf

o
 changes
 update [options] Update one saved MCP server
 delete|remove [options] Delet
e one saved MCP server\n connect [options] Connect an MCP server URL to a project, authorizing\n
in a browser if needed\n connect-status [options] Check a connection request started by `server\n
connect`\n connect-cancel [options] Cancel a pending connection request started by\n `server connect`
